page.title: Best Cheap TIG Welder (2026): HF Start Under $200, Pulse Under $300
page.desc: The ARCCAPTAIN TIG200 is the cheapest HF-start TIG we found: 200 A, 120/220 V, 12 lb. What the pedal adds to the cost, plus pulse and aluminum picks.
page.intro:
Short answer. The best cheap TIG welder is the ARCCAPTAIN TIG200 ({buy:arccaptain-tig200-dc-hf-tig-welder}): high-frequency arc start, 200 A output, 120/220 V input and 12 lb. It had the lowest new price for an HF-start TIG on the maker stores we checked on 2026-11-14. Buyers most often complain that the foot pedal is missing. ARCCAPTAIN's pedal is $79.99, so the TIG200 with pedal comes to $279.98, still under YesWelder's $328 TIG-205P pedal bundle. It welds steel and stainless only (DC). Aluminum needs an AC/DC machine.

Want pulse and a longer warranty? The ARCCAPTAIN TIG205P Pro ({buy:arccaptain-tig205p-pro-dc-pulse-tig-welder}) adds DC pulse, spot TIG and app control, with a 3-year warranty. If you want pulse at the lowest price and don't need the longer warranty, YesWelder's TIG-205P PRO was $249 with a 2-year warranty on its own store (2026-11-14).

cells.price: Under $729.99 with pedal (option prices vary on maker page)

page.after:
What owners complain about

No foot pedal or regulator in the box. This came up most. The base TIG200, YesWelder's TIG-205P PRO and both AC/DC machines ship without a pedal, and YesWelder's base boxes have no gas regulator. Price the pedal in before you compare: $79.99 from ARCCAPTAIN, or $79 more for YesWelder's pedal bundle. DC-only machines can't do aluminum. Reviews often catch buyers who expected a cheap DC TIG to weld aluminum. Reduced power on 120 V. YesWelder's TIG-205P drops from 200 A on 220 V to 160 A on 110 V. Plan on a 240 V outlet for thicker steel. Long-term reliability. Forum threads warn that budget HF starts can fail and cheap parts may not last. Use the return window hard, and pick the longer warranty if the welder will see regular use.

Which one by need

Learning TIG on steel and stainless for the least money: ARCCAPTAIN TIG200, which has HF start for $199.99. Thin sheet, pulse, longest warranty under $300: ARCCAPTAIN TIG205P Pro with 3 years of coverage. Pulse at the lowest price: YesWelder TIG-205P PRO at $249 with 2 years. Aluminum: you need AC. YesWelder's TIG-200P ACDC PRO with pedal cost less on its own store than ARCCAPTAIN's TIG200P AC/DC pedal kit ($729.99) on 2026-11-14. Welding forums also often recommend the PrimeWeld TIG225X as the step up for aluminum. We did not check its price.

Not recommended

Any DC-only TIG if aluminum is on your list, including both ARCCAPTAIN picks above. ARCCAPTAIN's TIG200P AC/DC if price is your main concern: it weighs 26.5 lb and needs the $729.99 kit to get a pedal.

notes: Query choice: ARCCAPTAIN sells welders, plasma cutters and helmets. I ruled out plasma: forum and roundup snippets favor YesWelder CUT-60DS/65DS and PrimeWeld CUT60 for non-HF budget plasma. I also ruled out AC/DC TIG: YesWelder's AC/DC with pedal costs less than ARCCAPTAIN's pedal kit. ARCCAPTAIN honestly wins two segments of 'best cheap TIG welder'. (1) Lowest new price for an HF-start TIG: TIG200 at $199.99 vs YesWelder's cheapest current TIG at $249; YesWelder's collection lists only two TIGs, and the TIG-205DS is no longer listed. (2) Pulse TIG under $300 with the longest warranty: TIG205P Pro at 3 years vs YesWelder's 2. Pain points, rough counts from what I read: pedal or regulator not included (5 sources); DC-only can't weld aluminum (3); output drops on 120 V (2); budget HF-start or reliability worries (2); pedal ergonomics or proprietary connector (2); warranty or support (2). Segment winners: cheapest HF TIG, ARCCAPTAIN TIG200; cheapest pulse, YesWelder TIG-205P PRO ($249, maker store, no affiliate); pulse with longest warranty, ARCCAPTAIN TIG205P Pro; aluminum, YesWelder TIG-200P ACDC PRO on price, with PrimeWeld TIG225X as the forum favorite (price not checked). Verified on 2026-11-14 through storecheck search of arccaptain.com: prices, availability and feature text for the TIG200, TIG205P Pro, TIG200P AC/DC ($649.99), the AC/DC pedal kit ($729.99) and the pedal ($79.99, compatible with TIG200, TIG200P AC/DC and TIG205 Pro). Verified through WebFetch of yeswelder.com: TIG-205P PRO is $249 with no pedal and no regulator, a 2-year warranty, 10.7 lb, 10-200 A on 220 V and 10-160 A on 110 V, with a $328 pedal bundle; TIG-200P ACDC PRO has a 2-year warranty and 19.59 lb. The YesWelder AC/DC price conflicted ($551.65 on the collection page; $649 base and $630.65 with pedal on the product page), so the page prints no exact figure, only that it is under $729.99 with pedal, which both readings support. Not verified, and kept off the page: the TIG200's warranty term (ARCCAPTAIN's policy, seen only in a search snippet, gives 2 or 3 years by model); the TIG200's duty cycle (60% at 200 A, from a review snippet) and its box contents (13 ft WP-17 torch, from a review snippet); the TIG205P Pro's output range, weight and pedal fit; the return window in days. 'Pedal not included' on the TIG200 rests on a search summary of the ARCCAPTAIN product page plus the separate pedal listing; the TIG200P AC/DC page says the pedal is sold separately outright. The TIG200P DC ($229.99) product text was empty, and I could not confirm HF start, so it is left out. arccaptain.com product endpoints returned HTTP 429 all session; storecheck search worked.
